tokens.name: med-navy
tokens.usage: BRAND · "Med"/"SOURCE" navy of the logos; section heads, label bars, corner triangles, links. 10.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: med-navy-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest navy field: footers, hero grounds. Text on it is on-dark.

tokens.name: navy-light
tokens.usage: Info icons and small accents; white text on it 5.4:1.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: THE POP COLOUR · Emphasis pills (Mura, ALL) with white Bold display text, thin stripes between bands, tagline accents on navy, arrows, green CTA blocks with navy-deep text. Never a full-page flood. Small text on it: navy-deep or ink.

tokens.name: mura-green
tokens.usage: LEGACY · The older, softer tagline green. Replaced by brand-green #7AB537 for all tagline accents (it pops more from a distance). Keep only to match old artwork.

tokens.name: brand-green-strong
tokens.usage: Green buttons and badges that carry small white text (4.9:1); green text at body size on white.

tokens.name: leaf-light
tokens.usage: Light green for decoration, illustrations and tints — never text. (Also the top of the logo's cross gradient.)

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: HOUSE · Dominant panel colour: diagonal panels, full-bleed pages, footers. White text on it 7.2:1.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: HOUSE · Sage panels and secondary fills; white/on-dark text on it 5.2:1 in both themes. For sage-coloured text use sage-text.

tokens.name: sage-text
tokens.usage: Sage as text: the bold line of two-line titles. 5.2:1 on white, 7.3:1 on the dark ground.

tokens.name: sage-tint
tokens.usage: Light sage cards and tip boxes on white or cream; forest text on it 6.3:1.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Document, print and default ground.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Social-only warm ground. Never mixed with white in one piece.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Light sections and cards on white.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: The logo tagline colour ("MEDICAL SUPPLIES & EQUIPMENT"), captions and metadata — a navy-leaning grey (6.0:1 on white).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, the light line of two-line titles, "WORLD" and "Certified" (17:1 on white).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and borders.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text/icons on med-navy, brand-green-strong or navy-light fills.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text, white logos and icons on forest, sage, med-navy-deep.

tokens.name: promo-red
tokens.usage: Sale bursts only, small. White on it 5.6:1.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links — alias of med-navy.

groups.name: House — Poppins
groups.note: Poppins is the house face: it draws the MedSource wordmark and sets everything in publications. Titles are ALL CAPS in two lines — Regular in ink, then Bold in sage (on white) or white (on forest).

styles.name: title-light
styles.usage: First line of a two-line title ("OUR", "ABOUT OUR", "BUSINESS", "GET"). ink on white, white on forest.

styles.name: title-bold
styles.usage: Second line of the title. sage on white, white on forest. Followed by a short 90px rule.

styles.name: section-head
styles.usage: Section heads in caps, med-navy on white.

styles.name: label-bar
styles.usage: White caps inside a med-navy (or forest) bar — service names, VISION / MISSION.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: To provide quality, reliable and innovative medical items via trusted global sourcing.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: MedSource World serves as a comprehensive, one-stop medical outlet for individuals and institutions.
styles.usage: Running text, justified in documents (9–11pt in print).

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices on promos; peso sign same size.

groups.name: Wordmarks & taglines — Poppins
groups.note: Reference styles. Always place the logo files. MedSource is Poppins Bold; MedSource World is Montserrat (MED green, SOURCE navy, WORLD regular) and stays that way inside its logo.

styles.name: wordmark-ref
styles.usage: Retail wordmark: Med navy + Source logo green #62A40B.

styles.name: world-ref
styles.usage: World wordmark (Montserrat in the logo): MED brand-green + SOURCE navy, caps, over WORLD.

styles.name: tagline-medicall
styles.usage: "Trust us, we've got it" (16px Medium navy) over Medic (brand-green) + ALL (navy).

groups.name: Canva social extras (optional)
groups.note: Cy Grotesk V3 Key, Public Sans and Open Sauce live in the Canva kit for social posts. Optional — Poppins alone covers everything; if used, Cy Grotesk only for one punchy headline per post.

styles.name: social-punch
styles.usage: Optional social headline. Never in documents or the company profile.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges and tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related lines.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, button padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks in a layout.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Safe margin of a 1080px post at 1:2.5 scale; section gaps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Outer margin of publications.

radius.note: Soft corners, taken from the rounded arms of the cross.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs, price chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, product cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Photo frames, large panels — the cross's own corner.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: call-to-action and contact chips.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Product cards lifted off a photo or tint — the only shadow. Never on the logo.
